Name: Elishama, Son of David
Summary: Elishama, son of David, was born at Jerusalem and named among the sons born to him there. He is distinct from Elishama son of Ammihud, prince of Ephraim.
KeyStory: Elishama son of David was born at Jerusalem, sharing a name with Ephraim's prince.
LifeLesson: The same name in two tribes, two stories — the record tells them apart.
